newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Regional Resources could be suspended - JSE.
newsitem.headline: Regional Resources could be suspended - JSE.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said on Monday the listing of South African mining exploration firm Regional Resources Ltd could be suspended or terminated because of its failure to submit its listing provisionals on time.
The bourse said its listing requirements stipulated that listing provisionals be submitted within a three month period.

"The company has failed to submit its provisionals timeously and...the listing of its securities is under threat of suspension and possible termination," the JSE said in a statement, adding the company had been given until June 30, to look into the matter.
